# Commit m2
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], capture_output=True, text=True)
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'm2: Extend iterutils.partition to accept multiple predicates'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Exit code:", result.returncode)
print("stdout:", result.stdout[:500])
print("stderr:", result.stderr[:500])

# Verify commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\nCommits:")
print(result.stdout)
